prompts.torreao:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE native-resolution pixel-art enemy animation spritesheet for Sega Mega Drive SGDK, original industrial dark-space science fiction with steampunk machinery. Mood references: grim armored space infantry, Gothic military science fiction, StarCraft-style industrial soldiers, Warhammer-style bulky armor, without logos or exact existing characters. Preserve original readable silhouette. Side view facing RIGHT in every frame.
STRICT OUTPUT: transparent PNG canvas EXACTLY 192 pixels wide by 96 pixels high. Draw pixel art directly at this native resolution, NOT a high-resolution illustration. No enlarged output, no antialiasing, blur, gradients, semitransparency, outlines around cells, grid, margins, gutters, text, numbers, captions, environment, ground plane, drop shadows, watermarks or palette swatches.
REGISTRATION: precisely 6 columns x 2 rows of cells each exactly 32x48 px. Cell origin x=32*column,y=48*row. Keep ALL pixels of each pose inside its own cell. Feet baseline local y=46, center between feet local x=16. Head fits near local y=5, body silhouette typically width 22-28 px, some headroom. Fixed anatomy and scale every frame. Strong readable pixel clusters and economical 2-tone shading. Compact gun and backpack do not extend beyond cell.
TOP ROW: columns 0,1,2,3 = exactly FOUR idle frames, subtle boiler vibration and breathing, feet fixed. Columns 4 and 5 = entirely transparent empty cells.
BOTTOM ROW: columns 0 through 5 = exactly SIX distinct running frames in a seamless complete cycle, contact, compression, push-off, passing, opposite contact, recovery, alternating arms and legs. Feet rise intentionally in airborne pose. All characters run right. Readable distinct silhouettes, no duplicated poses.
ONE SHARED PALETTE: index 0 transparent; 15 opaque visible colors only. Use only these exact RGB hex colors: #000000, #242424, #494949, #6D6D6D, #929292, #DBDBB6, #492400, #926D24, #DBB649, #6D0000, #DB2424, #DBDB24, #49246D, #9249B6, #DB6D00. Color blocks on 3-bit Mega Drive RGB grid. Black/gunmetal outlines, dark steel shadows, gray steel highlights, brass/copper accents, strongest family color across shoulders and torso. No cyan/green or extra colors. This SAME palette is required on every sheet in this collection.
CHARACTER: Torreão, red heavy stationary gunner. bulky scarab-shaped plated power armor, compact shoulder cannon facing right, domed riveted helmet, brass boiler backpack and pipes, thick boots. Main armor saturated RED, brass highlights. Idle should read as a resistant stationary sentry; run is a heavy emergency repositioning cycle. Entire sheet contains only this ONE consistent character ten times and two empty cells.
